market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Warsh hawkish tone at Jackson Hole suppresses rate-cut hopes. Mortgage rates rising. S&P 500 breadth weak—narrow leadership (MSFT, NVDA, PLTR) masking underlying fragility. Korean chip ETF outflows signal risk-off in momentum trades. Jobs report and Broadcom earnings next week are critical catalysts. Apple Sept 1 transition adds event risk. Expect 2-4% volatility range.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure, defense, and energy transition offer structural growth. US fiscal trajectory ($40T) is the dominant long-term risk. Consumer caution pressures retail. If Fed holds rates, equities re-rate on earnings (currently growing fast but unsustainable per headline 45). 6-12 month: favor quality, dividends, and geopolitical hedges over broad beta.
